title: Codon DNA → 6D Jordan Algebra Routing Integration
summary: Ports the Python codon project (64-codon DNA → 6D Jordan algebra routing) into the Zig/Q#/sidecar proof architecture. Cross-wires codon channels to octonion basis, 3-qubit states, 15-layer central row, and Smith/Möbius boundary.

key_concepts.codon_encoding: 6-bit base-4 index: A=00, C=01, G=10, U=11, first base most significant (idx = b0<<4 | b1<<2 | b2)
key_concepts.chemistry_qubit_coords: qx = floor((mw_sum - 970) / 30) % 2, qy = floor(ring_hbond_sum) % 2, qz = floor(no_sum) % 2
key_concepts.base_point: x = floor(((mw-323.2)/40)*14 + pos*phi) % 15, y = floor(rings*7+hbonds*2 + pos*pi) % 15, z = floor(((atoms-13)/3)*14 + pos*5.25) % 15

cross_wiring.qubit_state: 6-bit codon index -> 3-qubit computational basis (or 6-qubit for full encoding)
cross_wiring.central_row: channel -> 15x15 matrix central row [6,5,4,3,2,1,0,7,0,1,2,3,4,5,6] at position 7-channel
cross_wiring.smith_mobius: channel -> Gamma = (z-1)/(z+1) where z = channel index

scientific_limitations: Chemistry-derived routing fields use documented heuristics; source manuscripts do not define exact base-to-dimension mapping
PlaceholderSignatureBuilder and ChemistrySignatureBuilder produce different routing for polar/basic amino acids
Port verifies arithmetic identities and routing rule consistency, not the speculative biological interpretation
No genome classification accuracy or shuffled-control p-values computed in Zig/Q# port
Does not prove a physical Jordan algebra embedding
